label: SIMULATED - assumptions, not client outcomes

shortage_cost_per_unit.note: lost-sale penalty; ratio to holding = 100 (one lost unit costs as much as holding one unit for 100 days)

starting_stock_days_of_cover.note: starting on-hand = 14 x mu0, identical for every policy

mu0.note: calendar-day mean of observed sales in the 28 days ending at the episode start (unavailable days count as 0)

sigma0.note: std of daily observed sales on observation-available days in those 28 days

unavailable_day_demand.note: no source records -> no recorded sales

demand_proxy: observed positive merchandise units (censored by any historical stock-outs; not unconstrained demand)
end_of_episode: orders still in transit at the end of the episode are ignored for every policy
